notes: Use the final 18.250 coated bore D032. The 18.254 before-SURFALLOY dimension D031 describes a manufacturing stage, not a second finished bore.
Inspection rolls are not part material. The over-roll requirement controls cone placement; the 21.500 reference diameter is not substituted for it.

D038 is interpreted from its section extension lines as remaining web thickness under the radial keyways, correcting the extraction's bore-step interpretation. D041 is exclusively the radial depth of the distinct outside axial keyways.
The second starred .375 internal transition blend remains unresolved; resolve it before production release.

Angle D-IDs contain degrees despite the extraction's unit field. Numerical trigonometric coefficients are documented against the printed source angles because the IR expression evaluator accepts arithmetic only.
All coordinates are global and axis-centered. The extraction's envelope-corner hole instance coordinates are not used.

Large tapped holes use controlling rectangular ordinates, not an equally spaced eight-hole circle. Small tapped holes form four radial pairs. Tapped holes with null depth are through; threads are cosmetic, without an inferred fit class.
Material: 8620, carburize, quench and temper. R/C 58–62 as designated; all other surfaces R/C 35–38. Apply #3 SURFALLOY where indicated.
Retain the indicated 63 finishes, general 250 finish, datum A finished-bore axis, datum B rear face and .001 geometric controls as manufacturing and inspection annotations.
Starred radii are high-stress areas: smoothly blend adjacent surfaces, remove all tool marks and polish if necessary.
Manufacturing routing must complete all machining and finishing before the sawcuts. The general edge-break size remains unresolved.
